note: Single source of the security headers of the sites this repository serves (deploy/headers.mjs turns it into nginx snippets and into what tests/csp-f0.mjs serves). Elffuss Link spec §4.4. Placeholders: {self} = the site's origin, {inline:<file>} = the sha256 sources of that page's inline scripts. Policies are chosen by path like an nginx map on $uri: exact paths, then regexes in order, then default.

policies.name: app
policies.why: Claw itself. Scripts only from this origin (third-party code is vendored: web/vendor/third-party/, web/vendor/elffuss-ai/) plus WebAssembly; the one inline script is the import map, by hash. Frames: this origin (the app viewer's sandbox page, the memory store), the model stores (models, m1, m2: js/runtime/model-broker.js frames the one of each weight host) and the SoundCloud player of the Mind. Connections: this origin (/proxy, /websearch, /proxy/report), the model hosts, Hugging Face (and the hf.co hosts its downloads redirect to), GitHub (skills), the API providers of Settings and a model server on this computer. Only elffuss.com may frame it (the chat's apps panel, chat/appview.js). COOP stays unsafe-none: Claw answers the Copilot and the Translator that open it, through window.opener.
csp: connect-src 'self' data: blob: https://models.elffuss.com https://m1.elffuss.com https://m2.elffuss.com https://huggingface.co https://*.huggingface.co https://hf.co https://*.hf.co https://api.github.com https://raw.githubusercontent.com https://api.openai.com https://api.anthropic.com http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*

headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(self), microphone=(self), geolocation=(), autoplay=(self "https://w.soundcloud.com"), encrypted-media=(self "https://w.soundcloud.com"), usb=(), serial=(), hid=(), bluetooth=(), midi=(), payment=(), display-capture=(), xr-spatial-tracking=(), browsing-topics=()

policies.name: bridge
policies.why: The hidden page the chat of elffuss.com embeds to reach Claw's apps (js/bridge.js). Only elffuss.com may frame it. The page's own meta policy is kept; this adds what a meta cannot (frame-ancestors).

headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), usb=(), serial=(), hid=(), bluetooth=(), midi=(), payment=(), display-capture=(), browsing-topics=()

policies.name: sandbox
policies.why: The page the apps, the loading demos and the game checker are written into (web/sandbox/run.html, js/sandbox-frame.js). The `sandbox` directive gives it an opaque origin even when opened on its own; its flags are those of the app viewer's iframe. What runs there is what the model made, as before (a srcdoc frame had no policy at all): it may run inline code and load what it wants, but it cannot reach Claw's storage. Only Claw frames it, also when Claw itself is framed by elffuss.com (frame-ancestors checks every ancestor).
csp: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-modals allow-popups allow-downloads

headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), usb=(), serial=(), hid=(), bluetooth=(), midi=(), payment=(), display-capture=(), browsing-topics=()

policies.name: none
policies.why: Paths with headers of their own: the memory store (server/memory/headers.conf, its own location) and the backends (/proxy answers with its own sandboxing CSP).

models.elffuss.com.note: The shared model store (server/broker/), served on models, m1 and m2 .elffuss.com. Only the store's two files get a policy; the weights on m1/m2 keep their headers.

policies.name: store
policies.why: The store page, a hidden iframe in every Elffuss site. Its one inline module, by hash. It downloads whatever model URL an allowed site asks for, so connect-src stays https:. frame-ancestors lists exactly the origins its allowed() accepts (no ?allow= third parties: a new one has to be added here too). The hash is of server/broker/index.html, which must be the page actually served (check: curl -s https://models.elffuss.com/ | shasum -a 256 equals shasum of that file; node deploy/headers.mjs --print models.elffuss.com /).
